items.title: Why language models hallucinate
items.summary: OpenAI’s new research explains why language models hallucinate. The findings show how improved evaluations can enhance AI reliability, honesty, and safety.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于语言模型幻觉成因的最新研究成果。研究表明，通过改进模型的评估方法，可以显著增强AI系统的可靠性、诚实度与安全性，为解决大语言模型普遍存在的幻觉问题提供了理论和实践指导。原始信息显示：OpenAI’s new research explains why language models hallucinate. The findings show how improved evaluations can enhance AI reliability, honesty, and safety.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Why language models hallucinate”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了关于语言模型幻觉成因及如何通过改进评估来提升可靠性的重要研究。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

items.title: OpenAI and Greek Government launch ‘OpenAI for Greece’
items.summary: OpenAI and the Greek Government have launched “OpenAI for Greece” to bring ChatGPT Edu into secondary schools and support responsible AI learning. This partnership aims to boost AI literacy, fuel local start-ups, and drive national economic growth.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI与希腊政府合作启动了“OpenAI for Greece”项目，将ChatGPT Edu引入中等学校，旨在支持负责任的AI学习，提升全民AI素养，并助力当地初创企业与国家经济增长。原始信息显示：OpenAI and the Greek Government have launched “OpenAI for Greece” to bring ChatGPT Edu into secondary schools and support responsible AI learning. This partnership aims to boost AI literacy, fuel local start-ups, and drive national economic growth.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI and Greek Government launch ‘OpenAI for Greece’”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI与希腊政府合作推出“OpenAI for Greece”计划，推动教育领域的AI应用。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
